scope: Inference from source-guaranteed one BF16 vocabulary head per prediction and exact complete-request call counts, verified against all forced-head records. No explicit runtime phase marker. Captures selected-global-alpha diagnostic, not the new fused route. Raw ticks and sampled ranks are not milliseconds or unbiased end-to-end time shares; intervals may overlap and heads are oversampled. Earlier prefill chunks and vision commands without a vocabulary head are excluded.
